issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath grammar STRING/ESC/UNICODE (fhirpath.g4): \u requires exactly 4 hex digits; undefined escapes not in ESC set
issues.evidence: fhirpath(?::JSON,'bad \uZZ hex') and 'short \u41' return 'bad uZZ hex'/'short u41' (backslash silently dropped) identically in native extension and Python fallback; fhirpath_is_valid=true. Strict grammar reading would reject these lexically. Repo grammar comment documents deliberate raw-backslash tolerance (FP-10 corner). No official R4 fixture covers malformed \u or unknown escapes; both engines lockstep, UDF-surface outputs identical.
issues.root_cause: Documented tolerant-grammar corner: STRING fallback alternative ~['] admits raw backslash, and the unescape step drops it for unknown escapes
issues.resolution: DEFERRED: dual-engine parity holds, no fixture mandate, tightening would change documented FP-10 tolerance semantics; revisit only if an official fixture pins strict rejection
